channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLpolitics, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: House departs, but Hegseth impeachment, Epstein, funding fight await
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson has sent lawmakers home until after the midterms, but upon their return they will face a showdown over impeaching Defense Secretary Hegseth.

item.title: Khanna and Massie say they can force another Epstein vote
item.description: Reps. Ro Khanna and Thomas Massie said Thursday they have secured commitments for the 218 signatures needed to force another vote.

item.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman
item.description: Warren Buffett will step down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, less than a year after handing over the CEO role, the company said Friday.

item.title: Trump says CNN, MS NOW and Politico are banned, with more possible
item.description: President Trump said Friday he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House effective immediately, escalating his long-running battles.
